messages.subject: Time recording reminder — February narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Elena,

Our records show 6.5 hours of unposted time for February across two matters. Please complete your narratives by Friday so we can run the March client bills. If you believe this is in error, let us know.

Regards,
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
